pilot: OGI-013-PILOT-1 (exploratory, separate from the preregistered study): SINGLE vs RG2-COLLAB (OGI013_ORG_COLLAB=1)
status: PROPOSAL - not an authorization. Nothing runs until the owner approves exactly this file (sha256).
max_tokens_per_step_definition: owner-approved ceiling for ONE agent step (input + the whole answer incl. PlumMe continuations); the reservation is otherwise sized from the route's published output limit and the remaining budget; a step that cannot afford 2048 answer tokens is a budget stop, never a truncated answer
dispatch_definition: every provider dispatch = one row of the arm's plumme-state/receipts.jsonl (agent, reviewer, specialist, retry and simulator dispatches; the simulator's sim-usage rows are the same dispatches and are not counted twice); rejected attempts count
token_definition: recorded input+output usage; a successful dispatch without usage halts; a failure rejected before processing (PlumMe REJECTION_CLASSES) is known zero; any other failure without usage is charged reserve_tokens_per_dispatch
cash_definition: authorised cash is 0.00 USD. Route classes ANONYMOUS_FREE, FREE_TIER, LOCAL, TRIAL_CREDIT, INCLUDED are zero-cash (TRIAL_CREDIT / INCLUDED consume an entitlement, reported); any other or unknown route class without a recorded cost halts
enforcement: (1) PeachMe session budget configured for BOTH arms from this file (OGI013_SESSION_MAX_CALLS/TOKENS/COST_USD): reservation before every agent-side dispatch; (2) runners/ogi013_pilot_gate.py before every agent step and simulator attempt (all dispatches, cumulative, cash, unknown usage, failure streak); (3) pilot_guard.py watch as backstop
estimate_basis: ESTIMATE from archived c2 runs recounted without the old simulator double-count (task 29 adaptive: 37 dispatches / 143,638 tokens; task 6 adaptive: 31 / 97,637; task 24 adaptive: 48 / 41,609 but ended early under rate limiting; recorded tokens per successful agent call 2.4k-5.5k; simulator ~1.5k) and the failure profile of those runs (50-70% of dispatches were rejected before processing, 0 tokens). Expected SINGLE ~48 dispatches / ~70k tokens; COLLAB ~70 dispatches / ~115k tokens (each reviewed write adds <= 5 calls). Caps are ~1.4-1.6x the expectation.
